decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment lies far from the firm's maritime knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to interpret results or improve the service, and the resources are better spent on core integrated maritime solutions.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer know-how, so it can absorb market feedback and refine the service effectively.

The Smart Academy extends the firm's established training centres and is quickly building partnerships with six maritime institutions, which deepens its absorptive capacity through cooperation with research and education bodies.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance services sit close to the core technical management offer, have shown clear early success by meeting the regulatory deadline for all plans, and address a lasting regulatory need.
The FuelEU dashboard is fully integrated into the firm's own PAL software, so in-house development and software know-how let it learn from use and improve the tool alongside the compliance service.

The cost simulation tool builds on the firm's software and emissions-compliance expertise and supports its digitalisation and environmental-performance strategy, so it complements the dashboard and compliance services.
